entities.name: Payload container type
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of payload container included in the message.

entities.name: Payload container
entities.description: Information element that carries payload data in the message.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to request registration with the network.

entities.name: Payload container IE included
entities.description: Condition where the UE includes the Payload container IE in the message.

entities.name: UE policy container type
entities.description: Property specifying that the payload container type is set to UE policy container in REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

relations.description: Payload container type IE shall be included if the UE includes the Payload container IE.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the Payload container type IE.
In REGISTRATION REQUEST message, the Payload container type IE is set to UE policy container.
